description: This file defines a read-only struct 'MdDomMsg' used for representing messages within the MigraDoc Document Object Model. It includes properties for message ID, message string, and associated event information.

classes.name: MdDomMsg
classes.description: A readonly struct representing a DOM message with an ID and message content, along with event-related properties.

methods.name: MdDomMsg
methods.description: Constructor for the MdDomMsg struct, initializes the message with an ID and string.

methods.name: EventId
methods.description: Returns an EventId object constructed from the message ID and event name.

methods.name: EventName
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the message ID.
